name: Creation
summary: God creates the heavens, earth, and humanity in six days and rests on the seventh, establishing the pattern of the created order.

name: The fall and early humanity
summary: Sin enters the world through Adam and Eve's disobedience and escalates through Cain's murder of Abel, though the human line continues through Seth to Noah.

name: Noah and the flood
summary: Human wickedness leads God to judge the earth with a flood, preserving Noah's family and establishing a covenant never to destroy the earth this way again.

name: Nations and Babel
summary: The descendants of Noah spread into distinct nations and languages, an expansion that culminates in humanity's prideful attempt to build the tower of Babel.

name: Abraham's call and covenant
summary: God calls Abram out of his homeland and repeatedly promises him land, descendants, and blessing, sealing this covenant through dramatic signs and the mark of circumcision.

name: Abraham's family
summary: Abraham's family navigates the destruction of Sodom, the long-awaited birth of Isaac, and Sarah's death, ending with the search for a wife to carry the promise forward.

name: Jacob and Esau
summary: Twin rivals Esau and Jacob struggle from birth over the birthright and blessing, and Jacob flees his brother's anger toward his mother's homeland with a promise renewed at Bethel.

name: Jacob's family
summary: Jacob builds a large family and fortune under his uncle Laban, then returns to Canaan facing his estranged brother, family conflict, and personal loss along the way.

name: Joseph
summary: Sold into slavery by his own brothers, Joseph rises to power in Egypt and ultimately reconciles with his family, preserving them through famine and closing out Genesis.
